topic: Data payload exceeding specified time limits
summary_markdown: A data team member reported an issue where the API endpoint `/api/dashboard/traffic/charts` returns traffic data outside of the specified time window, even when parameters like `from-hour=11&to-hour=14` are used. Specifically, data points from times like 02:00:00 appear in the chart and are causing concern for users.
decisions: The issue needs to be fixed.
action_items: Create a task to address the API data leakage outside specified hours.
